description: Read the screen as text. Returns each element of the accessibility tree as ref role "label" x,y flags; views: the native view hierarchy instead. selector: only its matches, with state, value and bounds. Assert: check_element; pixels: take_screenshot; audits, visual diffs: check_screen; web views: inspect_app. Like rows fold under a header; refs hold across scrolls. raw: every node as data.
name: read_screen
title: Read screen
